steps.title: Mount P300 pipette
steps.instruction: Install the single‑channel P300 pipette on the specified mount (left or right) as indicated in the protocol parameters.

steps.title: Set up temperature module
steps.instruction: If the temperature module is to be used, set it to 12 °C and place the 96‑well PCR plate on it; otherwise place the plate directly on slot 1 of the robot deck.

steps.title: Place tubes in 32‑tube rack
steps.instruction: Load 1–46 tubes into the custom 32‑tube rack by rows, filling from slot 7 down to slot 4 as described.

steps.title: Prepare negative control
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL sterile Control Buffer (from a 1.5 mL tube) to the first PCR tube in an 8‑well strip (well A1) that contains lyophilized PCR mix, then resuspend.

steps.title: Normalize unknown samples
steps.instruction: For each unknown sample, transfer 50 µL of the sample in SAVD buffer (contained in a 5 mL tube) into 250 µL sterile Normalization Buffer (1.5 mL tube) and resuspend to create a normalized sample.

steps.title: Add normalized unknowns to PCR mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of each normalized unknown sample to the next PCR tube in the 8‑well strip (starting at column C1) that contains lyophilized PCR mix, then resuspend. For wells with powdered reagent, dispense roughly half the required volume at half‑well depth, then dispense the remaining volume at the bottom of the well and mix.

steps.title: Prepare positive control
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL sterile Normalization Buffer (1.5 mL tube) into the Positive Control tube (lyophilized PCR tube) and resuspend.

steps.title: Dispense positive control to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of the positive‑control mixture to well A12 and resuspend; then transfer 50 µL to well B1 and resuspend.
